source.title: Ljubav, poziv i TikTok: Don Tomina poruka mladima // saznanja o kojima se premalo govori

summary.title_hr: Ljubav, poziv i TikTok: Don Tomina poruka mladima // saznanja o kojima se premalo govori
summary.abstract_hr: U ovoj epizodi podcasta, voditeljica Iva Kraljević razgovara s don Tomislavom Lukačem, mladim salezijancem poznatim po digitalnoj evangelizaciji na TikToku i Instagramu. Razgovor obuhvaća njegov osobni poziv na svećeništvo, izazove i blagoslove prisutnosti na društvenim mrežama, te stavove Crkve o delikatnim temama poput pobačaja i homoseksualnosti. Don Tomislav dijeli savjete mladima o svjedočenju vjere i naglašava da je ljubav u braku odluka, a ne samo osjećaj, te da je ključno za mlade osjetiti ljubav roditelja i Boga. Podcast ističe važnost autentičnosti, istine i ljubavi u suvremenom svijetu.
key_points: Don Tomislav Lukač, unatoč introvertiranosti, koristi društvene mreže poput TikToka i Instagrama za evangelizaciju mladih, smatrajući to Božjim djelom koje mu pomaže doprijeti do onih daleko od Crkve.
Papa Franjo podržava digitalne misionare, naglašavajući važnost donošenja Boga, a ne sebe, u online prostor, što je ohrabrenje za svećenike aktivne na društvenim mrežama.
Rasprava o pobačaju ističe ga kao duboku traumu za žene i naglašava da je život djeteta zajednička odgovornost oba roditelja, a ne samo majke.

U kontekstu homoseksualnosti, naglašava se da Bog ne stvara ljude s homoseksualnim sklonostima, već da su one često posljedica nedostatka muške figure u djetinjstvu, te se spominje reintegrativna terapija kao put oslobađanja.
Celibat se opisuje kao jednako vrijedan poziv kao i brak, gdje svećenik postaje duhovni otac tisućama djece, pronalazeći ispunjenje u nesebičnoj ljubavi poput Kristove.
Ljubav u braku je odluka, a ne samo osjećaj, te se naglašava važnost duboke pripreme za brak koja nadilazi površne emocije i tjelesnu privlačnost.
Mladi su, unatoč bombardiranju raznim utjecajima, i dalje u potrazi za istinom i Kristom, a ključno je da osjete ljubav roditelja i Boga kako bi izbjegli traženje kompenzacija u pogrešnim stvarima.
Sotona može djelovati i kroz vjerski sadržaj, stoga je važno oslanjati se na provjereni nauk Crkve i izbjegavati neprovjerene interpretacije, posebno na društvenim mrežama.
summary.title_en: Love, vocation and TikTok: Don Toma's message to the youth // insights about which too little is spoken
summary.abstract_en: In this episode of the podcast, host Iva Kraljević talks with don Tomislav Lukač, a young Salesian known for digital evangelization on TikTok and Instagram. The conversation covers his personal call to the priesthood, the challenges and blessings of presence on social networks, and the positions of the Church on delicate topics such as abortion and homosexuality. Don Tomislav shares advice with young people about witnessing the faith and emphasizes that love in marriage is a decision, and not just a feeling, and that it is crucial for young people to feel the love of parents and God. The podcast highlights the importance of authenticity, truth, and love in the modern world.
key_points_en: Don Tomislav Lukač, despite introversion, uses social networks like TikTok and Instagram for the evangelization of youth, considering it God's work which helps him reach those far from the Church.
Pope Francis supports digital missionaries, emphasizing the importance of bringing God, and not oneself, into the online space, which is an encouragement for priests active on social networks.
The discussion on abortion highlights it as a deep trauma for women and emphasizes that the life of the child is a joint responsibility of both parents, and not only of the mother.

In the context of homosexuality, it is emphasized that God does not create people with homosexual inclinations, but that they are often the consequence of a lack of a male figure in childhood, and reintegrative therapy is mentioned as a path of liberation.
Celibacy is described as an equally valuable vocation as marriage, where a priest becomes a spiritual father to thousands of children, finding fulfillment in selfless love like Christ's.
Love in marriage is a decision, and not just a feeling, and the importance of deep preparation for marriage that transcends superficial emotions and physical attraction is emphasized.

Young people are, despite the bombardment by various influences, still in search of truth and Christ, and it is crucial that they feel the love of parents and God in order to avoid seeking compensations in wrong things.
Satan can also act through religious content, therefore it is important to rely on the proven teaching of the Church and avoid unverified interpretations, especially on social networks.
